issues.on_page: Cash 14,983 + Cash with county treasurer 2,427 (Total Governmental Funds); Restricted cash 201,702 also printed
issues.issue: No governmental cash total is printed. ending_cash is a sum the extractor made (marked computed), which conflicts with the 2026-11-06 ruling that cash is never derived. It also leaves out restricted cash 201,702.
The Keno Fund's only receipt line is 'Local', which is probably keno proceeds (keno/lottery). It is a context label with no printed breakdown, so the context checker needs to confirm it.

The function comes from the fund column, not this row, and is noted in 'note' instead of 'computed'. The 2026-11-12 ruling says to add the function only when it is printed. Milligan/Minden use 'Streets/Highways' for the same case.
